movement.definition: trailing path length in structural state space

net_transport_ratio.definition: net displacement/path length when movement exceeds threshold

inertial_echo_recurrence.definition: movement-unconditioned trailing persistence of state similarity
inertial_echo_recurrence.interpretation: return or regional permanence; cannot establish coherent recurrence

recurrence_persistence.definition: inertial_echo_recurrence when movement exceeds threshold; otherwise zero

transported_inherence_evidence.definition: similarity of transitions produced from recurrently equivalent source states; local transition continuity is used only when no recurrent source is available

transport_coherence.definition: causal memory state integrating transported_inherence_evidence only during sufficient movement
transport_coherence.no_evidence_update: carry previous coherence state without treating absence as failure

variation_capacity.definition: normalized effective rank of active structural update vectors in the causal geometry window
variation_capacity.claim_boundary: proxy for realized variation, not the complete counterfactual viability kernel

state_machine.IMITATIVE_ECHO: active AND inertial echo high AND transport coherence low
state_machine.COHERENCE_LOSS: active AND transport coherence low AND inertial echo not high
state_machine.RECURRENT: active AND coherence high AND recurrence persistence high AND variation not contracting
state_machine.CRYSTALLIZING: active AND coherence high AND recurrence persistence high AND variation contraction > 0.25
state_machine.VIABLE: active AND coherence high AND neither recurrent nor crystallizing
state_machine.UNRESOLVED: active but transport coherence has no supporting transition evidence

claim_boundary: Coherence is modeled as a remembered causal state, not as net displacement or energy supply.
The observer estimates preservation of transition relations in numeric structural state space; it does not inspect semantics.
Realized variation capacity is not identical to the full set of counterfactual viable futures.
Version 5 was specified after inspecting v4 minimal-perturbation results and remains exploratory.
Saved numeric observations are reused; no LLM receives observer information.
